question: Which of the following banks appointed Infosys Finacle to power its digital transformation in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Xac Bank**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **XacBank is a leading universal bank in Mongolia**__.

 __
 
• XacBank's 80 branches across the country offer comprehensive banking and financial solutions to consumers and SMEs.
 
• XacBank appointed Infosys Finacle to power its digital transformation in November 2020.
 
• With Finacle's digital core banking suite, XacBank will gain a comprehensive set of capabilities and an open platform to establish a robust foundation for its digital future.
 
• The Finacle solution suite will enable the bank to drive overall business transformation to improve client engagement, operational excellence, and the flexibility to introduce bespoke solutions on-demand, all of which will help the bank to continue to innovate and grow.
 
• **Tsevegjav Gumenjav** is the Chief Executive Officer XacBank.
 
• Finacle is the industry-leading digital banking solution suite from EdgeVerve Systems, a wholly-owned product subsidiary of Infosys.
 
• Finacle is used by banks in over 100 countries to service over a billion customers and 1.3 billion accounts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **HSBC **is the second largest bank in Europe.

 
 
• HSBC stands for Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation.
 
• HSBC is the first bank to introduce ATMs in India.
 
 
 
• **ADB **stands for Asian Development Bank.
 
 
• It was established on 19 December 1966.
 
• The headquarters of ADB is located in Manila, Philippines.
 
 
 
• **DBS Bank Ltd (DBS) **is a Singaporean based multinational banking and financial services corporation,
